sentences.en: Psychologists are experts in behavior and mental health, but can they have an impact on our physical health?
sentences.zh: 心理学家是行为和心理健康方面的专家，但他们能对我们的身体健康产生影响吗？

sentences.en: Behavioral health teams working in tandem with primary care physicians can improve outcomes and reduce coSt.
sentences.zh: 行为健康团队与初级保健医生协同工作，可以改善治疗效果并降低成本。

sentences.en: So how does it work?
sentences.zh: 那么它是如何运作的呢？

sentences.en: We speak with one psychologist who focuses on patient-centered and integrated health care, providing more comprehensive and coordinated care for patients and their families.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了一位专注于以患者为中心和综合医疗保健的心理学家，她为患者及其家人提供更全面、更协调的护理。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这是《心理学谈话》节目。

sentences.en: Parinda Khatri is a chief clinical officer at Cherokee Health Systems, a comprehensive community health care organization with 56 clinical sites in Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 帕琳达·卡特里是切诺基健康系统的首席临床官，这是一个综合性的社区医疗保健组织，在田纳西州设有56个临床点。

sentences.en: Dr. Khatri provides oversight and guidance on blended primary care and behavioral health services within the organization.
sentences.zh: 卡特里博士负责监督和指导该组织内混合初级保健和行为健康服务的开展。

sentences.en: In addition, she trains, consults, and presents extensively on integrated care.
sentences.zh: 此外，她还就综合护理进行广泛的培训、咨询和演讲。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us, Dr. Khatri.
sentences.zh: 感谢您参加我们的节目，卡特里博士。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We hear a lot today about integrated health care.
sentences.zh: 如今我们经常听到综合医疗保健这个词。

sentences.en: Are patient-centered health care and integrated health care the same thing?
sentences.zh: 以患者为中心的医疗保健和综合医疗保健是一回事吗？

sentences.en: Well, they certainly are related, but they are not the same thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它们确实相关，但并不是一回事。

sentences.en: Patient-centered care is really about a model of care that focuses on comprehensive, holistic care that is coordinated, provides access, and emphasizes quality and safety.
sentences.zh: 以患者为中心的护理实际上是一种护理模式，它侧重于全面、整体的护理，这种护理是协调一致的，提供便利的获取途径，并强调质量和安全。

sentences.en: And so patient-centered care is really an overall model of care and approach to care.
sentences.zh: 所以以患者为中心的护理实际上是一种整体的护理模式和护理方法。

sentences.en: Integrated care is a pathway, if you will, to patient-centered care.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，综合护理是通往以患者为中心护理的一条路径。

sentences.en: So integrated care is an approach to care in which primary care, medical clinicians,
sentences.zh: 因此，综合护理是一种护理方法，在这种方法中，初级保健医生、医疗临床医生，

sentences.en: and behavioral health clinicians work closely together as part of a team with patients and families using a very systematic and cost-effective approach for a defined population.
sentences.zh: 以及行为健康临床医生作为团队的一部分，与患者及其家人密切合作，针对特定人群采用非常系统且具有成本效益的方法。

sentences.en: And so that care may address mental health and substance abuse issues, health behaviors,
sentences.zh: 因此，这种护理可以解决心理健康和药物滥用问题、健康行为，

sentences.en: including their contribution to chronic medical illness, life stressors, crises, stress-related physical symptoms,
sentences.zh: 包括它们对慢性内科疾病、生活压力源、危机、压力相关身体症状的诱发作用，

sentences.en: health care utilization.
sentences.zh: 以及医疗保健的利用情况。

sentences.en: So what, for example, what is a patient-centered medical home?
sentences.zh: 那么，例如，什么是“以患者为中心的医疗之家”？

sentences.en: So a patient-centered medical home is a model of care that focuses on concepts of, of course,
sentences.zh: “以患者为中心的医疗之家”是一种护理模式，它侧重于以下概念：当然，

sentences.en: number one, patient-centered care, in which the patient is really a partner with their health care team.
sentences.zh: 第一，以患者为中心的护理，在这种模式中，患者确实是其医疗团队的合作伙伴。

sentences.en: The care is also comprehensive, and that means that all of the patient's health care needs,
sentences.zh: 护理也是全面的，这意味着患者所有的医疗保健需求，

sentences.en: including lifestyle management, prevention, wellness, as well as chronic and acute conditions are taken care of.
sentences.zh: 包括生活方式管理、预防、健康维护，以及慢性病和急性病，都会得到照顾。

sentences.en: So it's much more comprehensive than just focusing in one specific system, like your respiratory system or, you know, only a very certain set of issues in your body.
sentences.zh: 所以它比仅仅关注某一个特定系统（比如你的呼吸系统，或者你身体里某一组特定的问题）要全面得多。

sentences.en: It's really designed to cover all aspects of your health.
sentences.zh: 它确实旨在涵盖你健康的方方面面。

sentences.en: The care is also expected to be coordinated, so that means that in a patient-centered medical home,
sentences.zh: 护理也被要求是协调一致的，这意味着在“以患者为中心的医疗之家”中，

sentences.en: you are going to have a team of providers who are linking all the dots for you, if you will, if you have to go to different specialists, if you have to get different labs.
sentences.zh: 你将拥有一支医疗服务提供者团队，如果你需要去看不同的专科医生，或者需要进行不同的化验，他们会为你把所有环节串联起来。

sentences.en: All the different elements of the broader health care system are coordinated within this patient-centered home.
sentences.zh: 更广泛医疗保健系统的所有不同要素都在这个“以患者为中心的医疗之家”内进行协调。

sentences.en: And then certainly quality and safety is emphasized, that because the patient-centered medical home is such a core part
sentences.zh: 当然，质量和安全也受到强调，因为“以患者为中心的医疗之家”是如此核心的部分，

sentences.en: and almost a cornerstone in someone's health care, we really want to make sure that it is of the highest quality possible and that it's safe.
sentences.zh: 几乎是一个人医疗保健的基石，我们确实想确保它是最高质量的，并且是安全的。

sentences.en: So I have a primary care physician.
sentences.zh: 我有自己的初级保健医生。

sentences.en: You know, does that mean my care is being delivered in a patient-centered care model?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是否意味着我的护理是在以患者为中心的护理模式下提供的？

sentences.en: It's certainly a first step to getting patient-centered care is to have a primary care physician.
sentences.zh: 拥有初级保健医生确实是获得以患者为中心护理的第一步。

sentences.en: But, again, the core elements of how the care is provided, is it being patient, is it really engaging you as a partner,
sentences.zh: 但是，同样，护理提供的核心要素是：它是否以患者为中心？它是否真的让你作为合作伙伴参与其中？

sentences.en: is it comprehensive, is it coordinated, do you have easy access to your provider 24 hours a day, 7 days a week,
sentences.zh: 它是否全面？是否协调？你是否能每周7天、每天24小时轻松地联系到你的医疗服务提供者？

sentences.en: is there a strong commitment to quality and safety, all of those components have to be there.
sentences.zh: 是否有对质量和安全的坚定承诺？所有这些组成部分都必须具备。

sentences.en: So having a primary care physician is certainly the first step, but it's not the only step in getting good patient-centered care.
sentences.zh: 所以拥有初级保健医生当然是第一步，但它不是获得良好以患者为中心护理的唯一一步。

sentences.en: You know, patient-centered care is sometimes referred to as patient and family-centered health care.
sentences.zh: 你知道，以患者为中心的护理有时被称为以患者和家庭为中心的医疗保健。

sentences.en: You know, why is that?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: People have begun to realize that patients, individuals, don't live in isolation,
sentences.zh: 人们已经开始意识到，患者，即个人，并不是孤立生活的，

sentences.en: that we all have social networks and partnerships and relationships that are incredibly important to us.
sentences.zh: 我们都有社会网络、伙伴关系和人际关系，这对我们来说极其重要。

sentences.en: Not only are they important to us personally, they're important to our health.
sentences.zh: 它们不仅对我们个人很重要，对我们的健康也很重要。

sentences.en: Many of us live with other people.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人与他人共同生活。

sentences.en: We live perhaps with our parents, siblings, partners, children, extended families, friends.
sentences.zh: 我们可能与父母、兄弟姐妹、伴侣、孩子、大家庭成员、朋友住在一起。

sentences.en: All of these people construct a very important social network that has a very strong impact on any person's overall health status.
sentences.zh: 所有这些人构成了一个非常重要的社会网络，对任何人的整体健康状况都有非常强烈的影响。

sentences.en: Let's talk about some particularly pressing health conditions.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈一些特别紧迫的健康状况。

sentences.en: You know, obesity and diabetes, they're critical health problems for a large segment of the population.
sentences.zh: 你知道，肥胖和糖尿病，它们是很大一部分人群面临的关键健康问题。

sentences.en: Will patient-centered care help reverse the trends, you think, for these two diseases?
sentences.zh: 你认为以患者为中心的护理能帮助扭转这两种疾病的趋势吗？

sentences.en: Well, certainly the research data and our clinical experience seems to indicate that having patient-centered care is going to have a profound impact on chronic health conditions
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，研究数据和我们的临床经验似乎表明，采用以患者为中心的护理将对慢性健康状况产生深远影响，

sentences.en: as well as overall lifestyle behaviors such as the kinds of behaviors that can lead to obesity.
sentences.zh: 以及对整体生活方式行为（例如可能导致肥胖的行为）产生影响。

sentences.en: So when we think about really the pandemic of obesity, we have to think about all the different components that are involved, diet, nutrition,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们思考肥胖这种流行病时，我们必须考虑所有涉及的不同组成部分：饮食、营养，

sentences.en: certainly genetic vulnerability or predispositions, and also with diabetes, diet, activity level, overall self-management of health.
sentences.zh: 当然还有遗传易感性或倾向，对于糖尿病来说，还有饮食、活动水平、整体健康自我管理。

sentences.en: They're all important concepts and all important aspects of health.
sentences.zh: 它们都是重要的概念，也是健康的重要方面。

sentences.en: So if we have a model of care that's able to very aggressively partner with a person in addressing kind of the full scope of factors associated with obesity,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们拥有一种能够非常积极地与个人合作，解决与肥胖相关的所有因素的护理模式，

sentences.en: for example, how you eat, how active you are, and you have someone partnering with you in this process
sentences.zh: 例如，你的饮食方式、你的活动程度，并且在这个过程中有人与你合作，

sentences.en: and really walking alongside you in this process, certainly we have a much stronger likelihood of addressing this problem
sentences.zh: 并在这个过程中真正陪伴着你，我们当然更有可能解决这个问题，

sentences.en: and helping someone manage this problem and address it in an effective manner than if you don't have that team or that support around you.
sentences.zh: 并帮助某人管理这个问题，以有效的方式解决它，这比没有那个团队或周围没有那种支持要好得多。

sentences.en: And certainly for diabetes, this is even more so the case because within a patient-centered medical home,
sentences.zh: 当然，对于糖尿病来说，情况更是如此，因为在“以患者为中心的医疗之家”内，

sentences.en: a patient really partners with their health care team in setting self-management goals for themselves.
sentences.zh: 患者确实与他们的医疗团队合作，为自己设定自我管理目标。

sentences.en: We recognize that good management of diabetes, good management of glucose requires constant vigilance,
sentences.zh: 我们认识到，良好的糖尿病管理、良好的血糖管理需要持续的警惕，

sentences.en: checking sugars, taking insulin if that's prescribed, making significant changes in diet, making significant changes in lifestyle behaviors such as smoking and activity level,
sentences.zh: 监测血糖、按处方服用胰岛素、在饮食上做出重大改变、在吸烟和活动水平等生活方式行为上做出重大改变，

sentences.en: and to expect what person to do it on their own is, you know, certainly I think challenging
sentences.zh: 如果期望一个人独自完成这些，你知道，我确实认为这很有挑战性，

sentences.en: and we've recognized that these are major changes and, you know, if we can certainly work together
sentences.zh: 我们已经认识到这些是重大的改变，你知道，如果我们当然能一起努力，

sentences.en: and we have partners in to help us kind of walk this path to cheer us on when things are challenging,
sentences.zh: 并且有合作伙伴来帮助我们走过这段旅程，在困难时为我们加油，

sentences.en: to give us feedback from lab results to make sure that they're available to us whenever we feel like we're not doing as well,
sentences.zh: 在我们需要时提供化验结果反馈，以确保我们在感觉做得不够好时能获得这些信息，

sentences.en: that's going to, of course, create a much better environment for addressing these two very dangerous health conditions.
sentences.zh: 这当然会创造一个更好的环境来应对这两种非常危险的健康状况。

sentences.en: Now, the health system you work in, Cherokee Health System, is a leader in providing patient-centered care.
sentences.zh: 现在，你工作的医疗系统，切诺基健康系统，在提供以患者为中心的护理方面处于领先地位。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about how that works?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们它是如何运作的吗？

sentences.en: So Cherokee Health Systems is a federally qualified health center and a community mental health center.
sentences.zh: 切诺基健康系统是一家联邦认证的健康中心，也是一家社区心理健康中心。

sentences.en: We have a clinical service delivery model that has a paradigm of integrated health care services.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有一种临床服务交付模式，该模式具有综合医疗保健服务的范式。

sentences.en: And what that means on the ground is that when people come to our clinic, in fact, even when they call in, all of their health care needs are assessed.
sentences.zh: 在实际操作中，这意味着当人们来到我们的诊所时，甚至当他们打电话进来时，他们所有的医疗保健需求都会得到评估。

sentences.en: And so when at the point of care, when someone comes in for primary care services,
sentences.zh: 因此，在护理点，当有人来寻求初级保健服务时，

sentences.en: if there are any behavioral health issues, any health care issues that require behavioral health intervention,
sentences.zh: 如果存在任何行为健康问题，任何需要行为健康干预的医疗保健问题，

sentences.en: that person is able to access that service immediately on the spot in the exam room.
sentences.zh: 那个人能够在检查室现场立即获得该服务。

sentences.en: And so think about how powerful that is for someone to come into their medical doctor's office and to say, hey, I'm having a lot of stress at work or I'd like to lose weight
sentences.zh: 所以想想看，这对某人走进他们的内科医生办公室并说“嘿，我在工作中压力很大”或者“我想减肥”是多么有力，

sentences.en: or, man, I'm getting these migraines, I'm having a really hard time, even though I'm taking medication and managing it.
sentences.zh: 或者“天哪，我偏头痛发作，尽管我正在服药并进行管理，但我还是感到非常痛苦”。

sentences.en: Rather than just getting a card or a pamphlet to make an appointment somewhere else in the future,
sentences.zh: 而不是仅仅拿到一张卡片或小册子，去别的地方预约未来的时间，

sentences.en: in that moment, a psychologist is able to come and speak with you and help you set some goals, learn some behavioral strategies to manage those issues.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，心理学家就能过来与你交谈，帮助你设定一些目标，学习一些行为策略来管理这些问题。

sentences.en: So as a psychologist, which you are, what's your role on the patient-centered care team?
sentences.zh: 那么作为一名心理学家（你正是如此），你在以患者为中心的护理团队中扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: I think psychologists have a tremendous amount to offer on a patient-centered medical team or patient-centered health care team.
sentences.zh: 我认为心理学家在以患者为中心的医疗团队或以患者为中心的医疗保健团队中能做出巨大的贡献。

sentences.en: And the psychological contributions can range from certainly providing direct clinical services and assessment within that health care environment.
sentences.zh: 心理学家的贡献范围可以从在医疗环境中提供直接的临床服务和评估开始。

sentences.en: So in the trenches, seeing patients, conducting assessments, providing interventions and consulting with the health care team to improve the quality of care
sentences.zh: 所以，在第一线，诊治患者、进行评估、提供干预措施，并与医疗团队协商，以提高护理质量，

sentences.en: and provide access to care to each individual patient and their family.
sentences.zh: 并为每一位患者及其家人提供获得护理的机会。

sentences.en: But the role of psychology in a patient-centered medical home is much broader than that.
sentences.zh: 但心理学在“以患者为中心的医疗之家”中的作用远不止于此。

sentences.en: Psychologists can be involved in the program development and program evaluation component of PCMH.
sentences.zh: 心理学家可以参与“以患者为中心的医疗之家”（PCMH）的项目开发和项目评估部分。

sentences.en: As we discussed, quality and safety are key aspects and fundamental elements of a PCMH.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所讨论的，质量和安全是PCMH的关键方面和基本要素。

sentences.en: And so evaluating whether or not the interventions and the services provided are effective, not only for an individual but for an entire panel of patients,
sentences.zh: 因此，评估所提供的干预措施和服务是否有效，不仅对个人有效，而且对整个患者群体有效，

sentences.en: such as all the diabetics in the practice or everyone in the practice who has diagnosis of hypertension.
sentences.zh: 例如诊所里的所有糖尿病患者，或者诊所里所有被诊断患有高血压的人。

sentences.en: Also, we discussed the program development component.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们讨论了项目开发部分。

sentences.en: Part of what happens in a PCMH is an expectation of taking care of a population.
sentences.zh: PCMH中发生的一部分事情是对照顾特定人群的期望。

sentences.en: So that means that a psychologist can get involved in developing an overall program,
sentences.zh: 这意味着心理学家可以参与开发一个整体项目，

sentences.en: such as group interventions, protocols and guidelines, health education aids, teaching aids for patients,
sentences.zh: 例如团体干预、方案和指南、健康教育辅助工具、患者教学辅助工具，

sentences.en: that can help address the population health in aggregate, not individual or by individual.
sentences.zh: 这些工具可以帮助从总体上解决人群健康问题，而不是针对个人或逐个解决。

sentences.en: We know that depression has a high level of disease burden for the patient.
sentences.zh: 我们知道抑郁症给患者带来了很高的疾病负担。

sentences.en: You know, that is to say, you know, recognizing when a patient is depressed and getting them effective treatment is very important.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是说，识别患者何时患有抑郁症并让他们得到有效的治疗是非常重要的。

sentences.en: Is patient-centered care better at treating depression than traditional health care?
sentences.zh: 以患者为中心的护理在治疗抑郁症方面是否比传统医疗保健更好？

sentences.en: Well, certainly the data suggests that when we engage the patient in the process of their own health, that we take a partnership approach rather than a top-down, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，数据表明，当我们让患者参与到他们自身健康的过程中时，我们采取的是一种伙伴关系的方法，而不是自上而下的，你知道，

sentences.en: I-will-tell-you-what-to-do approach, that we're going to see better outcomes.
sentences.zh: 那种“我会告诉你该怎么做”的方法，我们会看到更好的结果。

sentences.en: That once patients are engaged, and particularly in a condition like depression, in which it's too easy, it's so easy for the patient to be passive and feel helpless
sentences.zh: 一旦患者参与进来，特别是在抑郁症这样的疾病中，患者太容易变得被动并感到无助，

sentences.en: and feel like something needs to be done, you know, to them.
sentences.zh: 并觉得需要有人对他们做些什么。

sentences.en: So certainly what we found is that partnering with the patient, having a patient-centered approach can markedly improve the likelihood of developing
sentences.zh: 所以我们当然发现，与患者合作，采取以患者为中心的方法，可以显著提高制定

sentences.en: and implementing management, depression management program, intervention, and treatment plan.
sentences.zh: 和实施管理、抑郁症管理项目、干预措施和治疗计划的可能性。

sentences.en: That's a really good fit for that specific patient, and we, you know, we recognize one size does not fit all, and so partnering with the patient helps us do that.
sentences.zh: 这对于特定的患者来说非常合适，而且我们知道，一种尺寸并不适合所有人，所以与患者合作有助于我们做到这一点。

sentences.en: The other thing that is really critical about patient-centered medical home and depression is that we recognize that depression is related to so many other health issues.
sentences.zh: 关于“以患者为中心的医疗之家”和抑郁症，另一件非常关键的事情是，我们认识到抑郁症与许多其他健康问题有关。

sentences.en: And so if we can address those other health issues, number one, we may be able to also improve the depression,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们能解决这些其他健康问题，第一，我们也可能能够改善抑郁症，

sentences.en: certainly when we all feel bad physically, you know, it's hard to feel good mentally, and vice versa, that if we can address and improve the depressive symptoms,
sentences.zh: 当然，当我们身体感觉不舒服时，你知道，心理上很难感觉良好，反之亦然，如果我们能解决并改善抑郁症状，

sentences.en: we certainly can help someone manage their health better and, by extension, improve their clinical outcomes for their other health conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们当然可以帮助某人更好地管理他们的健康，并由此改善他们其他健康状况的临床结果。

sentences.en: Well, Dr. Khatri, thank you so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 好了，卡特里博士，非常感谢您参加我们的节目。

sentences.en: It's been a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能与您交谈。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: For more information on integrated health care and patient-centered medical care, please visit our website at speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 有关综合医疗保健和以患者为中心的医疗护理的更多信息，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's Speaking of Psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国心理学会的《心理学谈话》节目，我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。
